title: crossbio-algo artifact
description: Machine-checkable artifact for each stage of the research loop. Prevents design-spec-code drift (e.g., SCOUT design said TruncatedSVD, code used np.linalg.svd — that drift is now detectable). Every stage emits artifact.md (human) + artifact.json (this schema, machine).

parent_artifact_id.description: upstream artifact this derives from — forms a chain (data-audit → design → spec → code)

provenance_hash.description: sha256(content)[:12] — detects tampering or silent drift

inputs.description: upstream artifact_ids + data that fed this stage

decision.description: the key decision/output of this stage

stage_fields.description: stage-specific structured fields — see artifact-validation.md for per-stage schema + cross-stage rules

$comment: Per-stage stage_fields (examples): data-audit={biological_unit,estimand,fatal_issues,cohort_structure,leakage_graph,split_strategy}; design={problem_definition,estimand,notation_and_shapes,objective_or_likelihood,identifiability,failure_boundaries,complexity}; spec={module_interfaces,acceptance_criteria(each traces to a failure_boundary),pseudocode_hashes}; viability={competitors_by_category,viability_dimensions,viability_total,viability_range,should_proceed}; brainstorm={candidates:[{title,hypothesis,gap,novelty_locus}],chosen_id}; audit={panel_findings,verdict,blocking}.
